title: Right Desk
story: Across the garden, the mirror workstation's labels are reversed, and Mira jokes that the building seems convinced everyone has only one useful hand. The engineer mirrors the left desk's four holds on the right hand, then mixes both sides without a diagram.

steps.objective: Join Ivo and Mira at the right desk.
Use the four right-hand stamps one at a time.
Edit the label: an opposite-hand stamp and a same-hand roll.
Complete the mixed approval form without a diagram.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Hold J (Shift), tap S on the left hand, and finish the name: capitalize the S in Sol.
success_criteria: Shift + S is observed (Shift held from J, then S on the other hand)
The local label shows the stamp's effect

task.prompt: Mirror workstation label: stamp with Shift + S. Safe local editor; labels are reversed until stamped.
task.accepts: text S typed as a capital

steps.expect: hold J until Shift engages (about 200 ms), then tap S
rejects: the plain letters of both keys typed as text

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the label; the stamp needs the hold on the right-hand key, then a left-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

task.activation_order: one hold at a time in this level

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Hold K (Command), tap Z: undo the reversed stamp.
success_criteria: Command + Z is observed (Command held from K, then Z on the other hand)
The local label shows the stamp's effect

task.prompt: Mirror workstation label: stamp with Command + Z. Safe local editor; labels are reversed until stamped.
task.accepts: Meta+Z event inside the label editor

steps.expect: hold K until Command engages (about 200 ms), then tap Z
rejects: the plain letters of both keys typed as text

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the label; the stamp needs the hold on the right-hand key, then a left-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

task.activation_order: one hold at a time in this level

The local label shows the stamp's effect

task.accepts: Alt+A event inside the label editor

rejects: the plain letters of both keys typed as text

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the label; the stamp needs the hold on the right-hand key, then a left-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

task.effect: a mark appears in the label's corner
task.activation_order: one hold at a time in this level

task.accepts: Ctrl+A event inside the label editor

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the label; the stamp needs the hold on the right-hand key, then a left-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

task.effect: a lock icon appears on the label
task.activation_order: one hold at a time in this level

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Edit one label with an opposite-hand stamp and type a same-hand roll that must stay text.
success_criteria: The label reads Sol jk exactly
The roll j then k typed as two plain letters and did not become Shift or Command

steps.expect: hold J (Shift), tap S, release, then type ol

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the label; the stamp needs the hold on the right-hand key, then a left-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

steps.expect: type jk as a quick roll of two plain letters

feedback.other: A held J or K becomes a modifier. Roll the two taps and release. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Complete a mixed approval form that needs a left-hand hold with a right-hand key and a right-hand hold with a left-hand key, with no diagram; plain letters stay text.
success_criteria: Each of the four right-hand holds is used once and each of the left-hand holds from level 04 is used at least once
The form lines match their targets

task.accepts: each stamp event observed; plain letters typed between stamps

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the label; the stamp needs the hold on the right-hand key, then a left-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: The mirror workstation has its labels reversed. Mirror the left desk with your right hand.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Funny. This building seems convinced everyone has only one useful hand.

dialogue.speaker: mirror_card
dialogue.text: To undo the reversed stamp, you need to press Command + Z.

hint.action: To undo the reversed stamp, you need to press Command + Z.
hint.gesture: Command is tap-hold K, then Z on the other hand.

dialogue.speaker: mirror_card
dialogue.text: To capitalize the S in Sol, you need to press Shift + S.

hint.action: To capitalize the S in Sol, you need to press Shift + S.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: To type "jk" in the label, you need to press J, then K.

hint.action: To type "jk" in the label, you need to press J, then K.
hint.gesture: tap J, tap K. A same-hand roll stays text.

dialogue.speaker: mirror_card
dialogue.text: To mark the label, you need to press Option + A.

hint.action: To mark the label, you need to press Option + A.
hint.gesture: Option is tap-hold L, then A on the other hand.

dialogue.speaker: mirror_card
dialogue.text: To lock the label, you need to press Control + A.

hint.action: To lock the label, you need to press Control + A.
hint.gesture: Control is tap-hold ;, then A on the other hand.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: The pinboard is lopsided and it looks like a person made it. The map on it points at the review desk.
dialogue.cue: Ivo 05: when the pinboard turns asymmetrical and human: pleased

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Someone annotated this card to prefer the right-hand route.
dialogue.cue: Engineer: inspecting a tampering artifact (Mirror card)

then.text: Orientation 05 complete: the pinboard points to the review desk.

state_changes.before: The mirror desk is dark; the wall pinboard is symmetrical and empty; Mira waits in the mailroom.
state_changes.after: The right desk lamp is warm, the pinboard is lopsided and human with a map pointing at the review desk, Mira heads back to the mailroom.

optional_artifact.name: Mirror card
caption: A stamp card annotated in a hurry.
Its author preferred the right-hand route and wrote down why.
The note was never added to the training script.

pace_copy.text: Approved route: left desk, then left desk.

review_notes: At 1366x768 the right desk stop (19,10) is east of centre and clears the keyboard inset (x 4-147). The camera clamps at the east edge so the avatar is at screen x about 224 and y about 100.
